question: The line that separates the crust from the mantle is known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Moho’s discontinuity.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Moho's discontinuity** is named after Croatian seismologist** Andrija Mohorovi.**
 
• Moho's discontinuity is the boundary between the** Earth's crust and the mantle,** where seismic waves change speed due to the difference in composition between the two layers. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Understanding the** structure and composition** of the Earth's layers is important for understanding **geological processes and predicting earthquakes.**
